canonical_project: Mainburg Mitterleite / Wambach data center (GE-MI Mitterleite)
owner: Betriebs- und Entwicklungsgesellschaft Mainburg with unnamed private investor
notes: Mainburg Bau- und Umweltausschuss agenda records a Vorbescheid (preliminary building decision) for a data center at Mitterleite 13, Wambach, Gemarkung Lindkirchen, approved unchanged 2025-04-08; Bebauungs- und Gruenordnungsplan GE/MI Mitterleite with FNP amendment (Deckblatt 147) in progress. Datacenter-Insider (2025-12-03) says planning should conclude by end-2025; DCD covered the proposal. OeDP local reports 150 MW initially targeted (500 MW discussed), entered as 150 MW target; developer name not public. Local opposition exists (change.org petition, OeDP).
